title: Seattle Conference on Scalability: YouTube Scalability
summary: Cuong Do of YouTube describes how a handful of engineers scaled the site, covering hardware, software and database scalability challenges during its rapid growth. The talk was given at the 2007 Seattle Conference on Scalability.
why: HN recommends it as a rich, concrete look at real-world system design and as evidence of YouTube's early Python stack.

quote.text: Really good talk with lots of jewels.
